item.title: Reverse Engineering LockBit 3.0 Ransomware — From Encrypted Binary to Full Dissection
item.description: A complete, A-to-Z reverse engineering analysis of a LockBit 3.0 (LockBit Black) ransomware sample — covering PE structure, encrypted sections, dynamic API resolution, polymorphic trampolines, modified RC4/Salsa20 cryptography, multi-threaded encryption, the leaked builder toolkit, and every anti-analysis trick baked into the binary.
